warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the 2x2v canonical Poisson-bracket kernels on a spherical metric with counter-streaming shear layers, the largest kernel family of the module in its two-configuration-dimension form. In `rt_can_pb_bgk_surf_sphere_khi_im_2x2v_p2.c`, `nl` (line 79) is the density of the inner shear layer; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong spherical metric, a wrong 2x2v surface flux or a wrong implicit BGK update changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 1.9e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 1.0e-4 (worst files `neut-imom.gkyl` and `neut-imom.gkyl`), a headroom of about 5329x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
